entities.name: Serafino dell'Aquila
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Serafino dell'Aquila or Aquilano, also called by the family name dei Ciminelli, was an Italian poet and musician. As a writer he was one of the foremost of the stylistic followers of Petrarch and his work was later influential on both French and English Petrarchan poets.
